0.long_answer: Following a COVID-19 infection, some children may develop a hyperinflammatory condition that resembles Kawasaki disease. This condition is characterized by persistent fever, systemic inflammation, and multi-organ involvement, and it may include symptoms such as rash, swollen hands and feet, red eyes, and abdominal pain. It has been widely recognized and termed Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome in Children (MIS-C). MIS-C is an important condition to monitor because it can progress rapidly and may lead to severe complications, requiring prompt medical intervention.
